description: Laughed unasked, and was told not to hunt the laugh.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Read old Capulet flat, and kept him among small orders.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Waited where nothing was written, and named what a pause can hold.
name: Will Kemp

description: Defended the hurry of the kitchen, wrote the pause, and refused a second and a crust.
name: William Shakespeare
